components.text:
______________________________________________________

  Whacko Revisited
  Milky Way Xtreme
  Remix by: Jheriko

  Original: Milky Way
______________________________________________________
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
I never really liked the Milky Way presets from the Whacko packs so I took it upon myself yo do my own version way back in 'Jheriko - Pack 6', however it was a shoddy effect which, although it looked more like an actual galaxy, lacked the high quality camera movements and dynamic shape of the Whacko Milky Way. When I approached this idea again I realised pretty quick that I would have to start from scratch, mostly since the new AVS features aren't exploited in these old presets. This preset contains very little actual code by UnConeD but the idea is his, even the HUD I slapped on top started out as a cheap rip of the 'Mission to Mars' HUD and evolved into this with some advice from UnConeD.
______________________________________________________
